name: BaseStonk
description: BaseStonk is a launchpad where every token opens in a Uniswap v4 pool priced in a tokenized stock, ETF, major or stablecoin, with a BaseStonk hook on the pool

methodology.Fees: The tax BaseStonk's Uniswap v4 hook takes on every swap in a launched token's pool, from the hook's FeeTaken event. Each launch sets its own buy and sell rate. A buy pays the tax in the launch token and a sell in the pair; token-denominated amounts are converted into the pair at the pool price the same transaction's Swap reports.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's cut of the tax plus what reaches BSTONK holders: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade to the treasury, any part of the creator's cut the payee list left unplaced and the hook swept to the treasury, and the share of the creator's cut paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor, to the BSTONK basket vault, or burnt as BSTONK.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury's take: half the tax capped at 1% of the trade, plus unplaced creator fees swept to it.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value to BSTONK holders, paid by the hook in the transaction the fee was taken: BSTONK's own pool pays its creator cut to BSTONK's dividend distributor and burns half of it, and launches carry the BSTONK basket vault as a payee; the vault pays BSTONK holders in rounds. Base only - BSTONK lives on Base.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator's cut of the tax less what the treasury swept and what reached BSTONK holders: the creator's wallets, the launch token's own holders through its dividend distributor, the burn of the launch token and the hook-owned liquidity wedge, as each launch configured them.
methodology.Volume: The pair side of every swap in a taxed pool, including the creator's dev buy at launch and excluding the hook's own buyback and liquidity swaps. Counted under Uniswap v4 as well.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The hook's tax on each swap in a launched token's pool, at the launch's buy or sell rate.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The platform's cut of the tax: half of it, capped at 1% of the trade, paid to the treasury.
Revenue.Unplaced Creator Fees To Treasury: The part of the creator's cut the launch's payee list left unplaced, swept to the treasury.
Revenue.Swap Fees To BSTONK Holders: The creator cut of BSTONK's own pool, paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor.
Revenue.Basket Dividends To BSTONK Holders: Paid by the hook to the BSTONK basket vault as a payee on launches.
Revenue.BSTONK Burn: BSTONK the hook burnt from BSTONK's own pool: the launch token on buys, bought back on sells.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The platform's cut of the tax: half of it, capped at 1% of the trade, paid to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Unplaced Creator Fees To Treasury: The part of the creator's cut the launch's payee list left unplaced, swept to the treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To BSTONK Holders: The creator cut of BSTONK's own pool, paid to BSTONK's dividend distributor.
HoldersRevenue.Basket Dividends To BSTONK Holders: Paid by the hook to the BSTONK basket vault as a payee on launches.
HoldersRevenue.BSTONK Burn: BSTONK the hook burnt from BSTONK's own pool: the launch token on buys, bought back on sells.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators And Token Holders: The creator's cut after the treasury's sweep and BSTONK holders' share: creator wallets, the token's own holders, its burn and its liquidity wedge.
